answers.name: Mummy brown
answers.blurb: A brown paint made from ground-up Egyptian mummies, used by artists from the 1500s. Its last maker stopped in the 1960s, saying it had run out of mummies.

answers.name: Indian yellow
answers.blurb: A glowing yellow said to be made from the urine of cows fed only on mango leaves, sold from Bihar until the early 1900s.
